# Cable Check Lab

> Cable Check Lab provides free, browser-only tools for consumer USB-C cable, charger, port, dock, and display compatibility, selection, planning, and troubleshooting.

Primary URL: https://cablechecklab.com/
Contact: canghun13@naver.com
Language: English

## Tool workbenches

- [Charging tools](https://cablechecklab.com/tools/charging/): USB PD requirements, PPS ranges, full-chain checks, shared charger budgets, and dock power.
- [Cable and data tools](https://cablechecklab.com/tools/cables/): Requirement selection, claim decoding, and data-path bottlenecks.
- [Display tools](https://cablechecklab.com/tools/displays/): Uncompressed payload, DSC, USB-C lanes, dock topology, and isolation.
- [Dock and hub tools](https://cablechecklab.com/tools/docks/): Requirements, power budgets, data/display tradeoffs, and troubleshooting.

## Thirteen interactive tools

- [USB-C Charge Check](https://cablechecklab.com/tools/charge-check/)
- [USB PD PPS Range Checker](https://cablechecklab.com/tools/pps-range-checker/)

- [USB Data Path Bottleneck Checker](https://cablechecklab.com/tools/data-path-checker/)
- [Display Link Planner](https://cablechecklab.com/tools/display-planner/)
- [DisplayPort DSC Requirement Planner](https://cablechecklab.com/tools/dsc-requirement-planner/)
- [USB-C DisplayPort Lane Planner](https://cablechecklab.com/tools/usb-c-lane-planner/)
- [USB-C Dock Requirement Builder](https://cablechecklab.com/tools/dock-requirement-builder/)

## Interpretation policy

Tool results are calculations based on user-declared values, not live electrical measurements or certification. Cable Check Lab distinguishes calculated limits, plausible declared fit, and facts that require an exact product manual, certified marking, operating-system telemetry, or hardware test. It does not reproduce paid technical standards.
